notes_for_editor: Only one source supports this record: the FFLA New Mexico list row. Two WebSearch queries and the association's alphabetical and info pages gave the same row, so the story stops below the 120-word floor on purpose. Unchecked leads: a tDAR index of 1995-96 Cuba Ranger District surveys with 'Cuba Mesa' in their titles (no lookout in the titles seen), and the NRHP multiple listing 'National Forest Fire Lookouts in the Southwestern Region'. The record's 'mobile' kind matches the list's 'Trailer'; no correction proposed. Site access and staffing are unknown.
